title: Not worth the money
body: For this price, I expected so much more from this app. It doesn’t have enough features for me to pay this much, and it also bugs a lot - especially when you watch stories. I really think it’s great that someone (who really understands the struggles) has made an app for ADHD’ers, as there are some really helpful features in the app, but it’s just wayyyyy too overpriced.
author: mussemoderen
